Use a ação “Copiar para histórico” em um: Use the Copy to history action on a completed generation. Data moves from the dados_entrada schema to the historico schema; repeated operations do not duplicate measurements.
Gera uma série somente para as zonas ati: Generates a series only for active zones in a separate database. Dry-bulb temperature, humidity, wind and other external variables come from the ERA5 historical reanalysis via Open-Meteo. Sub-hourly points are interpolated and marked as derived; dew point, wet-bulb temperature and indices are calculated.
